notes.title: v1.0.4 Last one for now I hope
notes.notes:
- Fixed crabs not being able to be fed in the personal tank
- Stopped having piggy banks starve in the personal tank
- Added gameplay options to in-game options menus not just from the main menu
- Rebalanced filter feeders a bit

Hopefully with this all the major bugs people have encountered are now fixed!

notes.title: v1.0.3 Yet another hotfix
notes.notes:
- Balance adjustments to cleaning and ghost frogs
- Let sharks eat trilobites
- Adjust some sound effects
- Added a background to the achievements menu

notes.title: v1.0.2 Another one
notes.notes:
- Added a retry button to levels
- Fixed the size of a button
- Fixed cleaning minigame being unplayable because of 1.0.1
- Sped up scene transitions
- Fixed store inventory resetting too often
- Nerfed ghosts a bit, nerfed cleaning a bit

notes.title: v1.0.1 Day one hotfix
notes.notes:
Bug fixes
- Dirty tank graphic no longer renders under pets
- Fixed localization of cards in your starting hand not updating
- Fixed missing Discord confirmation translation
- Changed a misleading achievement description
- Stopped pets dying after you've already won
- Fixed card getting stuck in hover state if the game paused while hovering
- Fixed minigame not unlocking if you alt-f4 the first time playing it
- Made collection minigame less frustrating by always picking the right coin when there's overlap

notes.title: Deckarium released!
notes.notes:
The game is now out! Thank you to everyone who played the demo during Next Fest! The demo now has an additional 3 levels added to it along with another minigame, save files transfer over so by all means play the updated demo before finalizing your purchase.

I've also bundled the Deckarium with my last game, Ernesto's Asteroid Arcade!

Okay bye I hope you enjoy the game!
